title: Check Charging Area Configuration in SSMS / Helix DB
summary: Use the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) to inspect charging-area records and confirm that each area has entrance IDs, exit IDs, and an explicit disabled status. This is a read-only diagnostic.
when_to_use: Use when investigating charging-area configuration in the live WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), including a suspected missing, inconsistent, or disabled charging area.
not_for: Determining charging-threshold behavior; the source identifies charging thresholds as a separate database model.
Replacing a live operational check of AGV or charger behavior.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support performs the read-only inspection in the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
Escalate configuration discrepancies to engineering when the charging-area row is missing, required identifiers are empty or inconsistent, or the area is unexpectedly disabled.
safety_notes: This procedure is read-only. Do not change charging-area configuration during the diagnostic.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the charging database model table for charging areas

access_required: L2_support access to the WCS / Helix DB through SSMS
system_preconditions: Identify the charging area being investigated before comparing its database record.

visual_references.description: WCS / Helix SSMS view showing the Robotics database model inventory and the charging-area configuration concepts, including entrance IDs, exit IDs, and disabled status.

steps.title: Open the charging database model in WCS / Helix DB (SSMS)
steps.purpose: Locate the live database model that stores separate charging areas.
steps.instruction: In WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), open the Robotics database model inventory and locate the charging database model table for charging areas. The source identifies this model as ChargingDatabaseModel; use the available live SSMS navigation rather than modifying the database.
steps.expected_result: The charging database model is available for inspection and the charging-area records can be viewed.
steps.healthy_condition: The charging database model and its charging-area records are present in the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
steps.failure_condition: The charging database model or the relevant charging-area records cannot be located.

actions.label: Locate charging model
actions.exact_action: Open the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) and locate the charging database model table for charging areas.

stop_or_escalate_if: The charging database model or relevant charging-area records are missing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The charging database model table stores separate charging areas as well as their entrance and exit locations.

steps.title: Inspect charging-area fields
steps.purpose: Verify that the charging-area record exposes the configuration fields needed for diagnosis.
steps.instruction: In the charging-area records in WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), inspect the entrance ID, exit ID, and disabled fields for the relevant charging area.
steps.expected_result: The relevant charging-area row contains values or explicit status entries for entrance ID, exit ID, and disabled status.
steps.healthy_condition: Entrance ID and exit ID are identifiable for the area, and the disabled field explicitly represents the area's status.
steps.failure_condition: Entrance ID or exit ID is empty or inconsistent, or the disabled field is absent or not explicitly represented.

actions.label: Inspect charging-area fields
actions.exact_action: Inspect the charging-area records for entrance ID, exit ID, and disabled fields.

stop_or_escalate_if: Required entrance or exit identifiers are empty or inconsistent.
The disabled status is not explicitly represented.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Charging areas have entrance IDs, exit IDs, and a disabled status.

steps.title: Compare the record with the investigated charging area
steps.purpose: Determine whether the live database configuration corresponds to the charging area under investigation.
steps.instruction: Compare the charging-area row in WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) with the charging area being investigated. Confirm that the entrance and exit identifiers are usable for that area and determine whether the disabled status is expected.
steps.expected_result: The relevant row is matched to the investigated charging area, its entrance and exit locations are identifiable, and its disabled status is explicitly understood as expected or unexpected.
steps.healthy_condition: The row matches the charging area under investigation, has usable entrance and exit identifiers, and is not unexpectedly marked disabled.
steps.failure_condition: The row cannot be matched to the investigated area, an identifier is inconsistent with the area, or the area is unexpectedly marked disabled.

actions.label: Compare live configuration
actions.exact_action: Compare the configured charging-area record with the charging area being investigated.

stop_or_escalate_if: The charging-area row cannot be matched to the area being investigated.
The area is unexpectedly marked disabled.
The configuration is missing or inconsistent.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Charging areas are mapped with entrance and exit locations and have a disabled status; each area has several chargers.

success_criteria: The relevant charging-area row is present in the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
The row contains identifiable entrance ID and exit ID values.
The disabled field explicitly represents the area's status.
The status is not unexpectedly disabled for the charging area under investigation.
No configuration changes are made during the diagnostic.
healthy_conditions: ChargingDatabaseModel is available in the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
The investigated charging area can be matched to a database row.
Entrance ID and exit ID are usable and identifiable.
The disabled status is explicit and expected.
failure_conditions: The entrance ID or exit ID is empty or inconsistent.
The disabled status is missing, unclear, or unexpectedly set to disabled.
The database record cannot be matched to the charging area being investigated.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to L2/engineering if the charging-area row is missing, required entrance or exit identifiers are empty or inconsistent, or the area is unexpectedly marked disabled.
Do not modify charging-area configuration as part of this diagnostic.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: The charging database model stores separate charging areas with entrance IDs, exit IDs, and disabled status.
